description: How much an amount comes to at FXHUB's live rate, for example "How much is 1,000 USD in GEL at FXHUB?" or "How many euros do I get for 5,000 GEL?". Returns the result at the standard rate, the rate used and which side applies, with notes on hours, limits, commission (none), how long a conversion takes, whether the amount qualifies for a special (custom or individual) rate and, for rubles, what FXHUB offers ruble clients. Indicative only: nothing is exchanged.

amount.description: Amount of the currency the user has, greater than 0.

channel.description: online (bank transfer: GEL, USD, EUR, RUB) or cash (exchange point). Default: online when both currencies are exchanged online, else cash.

from.description: Currency the user has, three-letter code such as USD.

language.description: Language of the text answer: en, ka (Georgian) or ru (Russian), usually the language the user writes in. Default en.

to.description: Currency the user wants, three-letter code such as GEL.

name: convert_currency
title: Calculate amount at FXHUB rates
